problem: The first-capital reservation was scored by the utility governor but routine claims could consume an idle capital first. Peacetime Monument and Granary claims could then interrupt its military build, including the queued last body.
change: Run the existing reservation in the shared main/hint claim chain, only for an active first-capital reservation after its expansion floor. Protect capital assault bodies and Rams/Towers from the Monument and Granary claims through that window. Existing builds and other city eligibility remain with their original policies; normal global census can change other idle-city choices indirectly.
